## ESTIMASI CADANGAN (lanjutan)

- (1) Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  yang  termasuk  dalam  aset  di  Indonesia.  Wilayah Barat  meliputi  beberapa  wilayah  kerja  diantaranya  South  Sumatera,  Rimau, Lematang, Blok A, South Natuna Sea Blok B, Blok Corridor, dan Sakakemang.
- (2) Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  yang  termasuk  dalam  aset  di  Indonesia.  Wilayah Timur  dan  Tengah  meliputi  beberapa  wilayah  kerja  diantaranya  Tarakan, Senoro-Toili, Simenggaris, Sampang, Bangkanai, dan Madura.
- (3) Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  yang  termasuk  dalam  aset  Internasional  meliputi beberapa wilayah kerja diantaranya Yaman, Thailand, Tanzania, dan Oman.
- (4) Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Rimau, dan South Sumatera berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi GaffneyCline per 31 Desember  2018, dengan hak partisipasi Grup 100% sampai dengan Oktober 2019 dan 65% per November 2019 sampai dengan seterusnya.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok  Lematang  berdasarkan  Dokumentasi Cadangan  Internal  per  31  Desember  2025,  sesuai  dengan  hak  partisipasi Grup untuk Blok Lematang sebesar 100%.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok  Senoro-Toili  (Lapangan  Gas  Senoro) berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi GaffneyCline per 31 Desember 2025, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 30%.

Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Senoro-Toili (Lapangan Tiaka) berdasarkan  Laporan  Sertifikasi  NSAI  per  31  Desember  2011,  dengan  hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 30%.

Estimasi cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok  A  berdasarkan  Laporan  Sertifikasi GaffneyCline  per  31  Desember  2024,  dengan  hak  partisipasi  Grup  sebesar 85%.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok  Tarakan  berdasarkan  Dokumentasi Cadangan Internal per 31 Desember 2025 sesuai dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 100%.

Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Yemen 9 berdasarkan Laporan McDaniel &amp; Associates Consultants Ltd per 31 Desember 2014, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 25%.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok  Sampang  berdasarkan  Dokumentasi Cadangan Internal per 31 Desember 2025, dengan hak partisipasi Grup  untuk Oyong - Wortel sebesar 45% dan Paus Biru sebesar 75%. Efektif per tanggal 3 April 2026, terdapat penyesuaian terhadap hak partisipasi Grup untuk Paus Biru dari 75% menjadi 100% berdasarkan surat Notice of Withdrawal from the Sampang PSC Extension and Paus Biru Development dari Cue Sampang Pty Ltd.

## RESERVES ESTIMATION (continued)

- (1) Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  Indonesian  assets.  The  West  region covering several working areas including South Sumatera, Rimau, Lematang, Block A, South Natuna Sea Block B, Corridor Block, and Sakakemang.
- (2) Estimated reserves of the Group for Indonesian assets. The East and Central Region  covering  several working  areas  including Tarakan,  Senoro-Toili, Simenggaris, Sampang, Bangkanai, and Madura.
- (3) Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  International  assets  covering  several working areas including Yemen, Thailand, Tanzania, and Oman.
- (4) Estimated reserves of the Group for Rimau Block and South Sumatera based on the GaffneyCline Certification Report as of December 31, 2018, with 100% the Group's participating interest until October 2019 and 65% as of November 2019 onwards.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Lematang Block were based on Internal Reserve  Documentation  as  of  December  31,  2025,  in  accordance  with  the Group's participating interest in the Lematang Block of 100%.

Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  Senoro-Toili  Block  (Senoro  Gas  Field) were  based  on  the  GaffneyCline  Certification  Report  as  of  December  31, 2025, with the Group's participating interest of 30%.

Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  Senoro-Toili  Block  (Tiaka  Field)  were based  on  the  NSAI  Certification  Report  as  of  December  31,  2011,  with  the Group's participating interest of 30%.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Block A were based on the GaffneyCline Certification  Report  as  of  December 31, 2024, with the Group's participating interest of 85%.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Tarakan Block were based on the Internal Reserves Documentation as of December  31, 2025 with the Group's participating interest of 100%.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Yemen 9 Block were based on McDaniel &amp;  Associates  Consultants  Ltd  Report  as  of  December  31,  2014,  with  the Group's participating interest of 25%.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Sampang Block were based on Internal Reserves Documentation as of December 31, 2025, with Group's participating interest of 45% for Oyong - Wortel and 75% for Paus Biru. Effective on 3 April 2026, Group's participating interest in Paus Biru has been adjusted from 75% to  100%  based  on  Notice  of  Withdrawal  from  the  Sampang  PSC  Extension and Paus Biru Development from Cue Sampang Pty Ltd.

## ESTIMASI CADANGAN (lanjutan)

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  South  Natuna  Sea  Blok  B  berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi GaffneyCline per 31 Desember 2020. Pengkinian taksiran data reserves  &amp;  resources pada  beberapa  Lapangan  (West  Belut,  Terubuk dan Siput) untuk keperluan Kontrak Jual Beli Gas Baru berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi  GaffneyCline  per  30  Juni  2023,  dengan  hak  partisipasi  Grup sebesar 40%.

Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Tanzania berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi ERCE per 31 Oktober 2014, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 20%.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Madura  Offshore  berdasarkan  Dokumentasi Internal per 31 Desember 2025, dengan hak partisipasi Grup untuk Maleo dan Peluang sebesar 67,5% dan Meliwis sebesar 77,5%.

Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Bangkanai berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi  DeGolyer  and  MacNaughton  per  31  Maret  2025  dan  taksiran Sumber Daya Kontinjen berdasarkan dokumentasi LAPI ITB per Januari 2019, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 70%.

Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Bualuang  berdasarkan  Laporan  Sertifikasi GaffneyCline  per  31  Desember  2020,  dengan  hak  partisipasi  Grup  sebesar 100%.

Estimasi  Cadangan  Grup  untuk  Oman  Block  56  berdasarkan  Laporan  2024 Field Development Plan, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 5%.

- (5) Estimasi cadangan Grup untuk Blok Corridor berdasarkan Laporan Sertifikasi DeGolyer and MacNaughton per 31 Desember 2024, dengan hak partisipasi Grup  sebesar  46%.  Dengan  telah  selesainya  akuisisi  Fortuna  International (Barbados),  Inc,  yang  memegang  hak  kepemilikan  tidak  langsung  sebesar 24%  di  PSC  Corridor  dari  Repsol  E&amp;P,  S.à.r.l.  efektif  pada  29  Juli  2025, terdapat penyesuaian terhadap hak partisipasi Grup untuk Blok Corridor dari 46%  menjadi  70%,  setelah  unitisasi  Lapangan  Suban  10%  dan  Lapangan Gelam 14%.

Grup  mengumumkan  keberhasilan  penyelesaian  divestasi  seluruh  saham Ophir  Vietnam  Block  12W  B.V.  ("OVBV")  kepada  Bitexco  Energy  Company Limited ("Transaksi") pada tanggal 19 April 2024. OVBV memiliki 31,875% hak partisipasi di Chim Sao dan Dua ("Blok 12W"), ladang minyak dan gas bumi yang berlokasi di Vietnam.

Estimated reserves of the Group for Madura Offshore were based on Internal Reserves  Documentation  as  of  December  31,  2025,  with  Group's  effective working interest of 67.5% for Maleo - Peluang Field and 77.5% for Meliwis.

Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  Bangkanai  Block  were  based  on  the DeGolyer  and  MacNaughton  Certification  as  of  March  31,  2025,  and  the Contingent Resources estimate were based on LAPI ITB documentation as of January, 2019, with the Group's participating interest of 70%.

Estimated  reserves  of  the  Group  for  Bualuang  were  based  on  GaffneyCline Certification  Report  as  of  December 31, 2020, with the Group's participating interest of 100%

Estimated reserves of the Group for Oman Block 56 were based on 2024 Field Development Plan Report, with Group's effective working interest of 5%.

Due  to  the  completion  of  the acquisition  of  Fortuna  International  (Barbados),  Inc,  which  holds  an  indirect 24%  interest  in  the  Corridor  Production  Sharing  Contract  ('Corridor  PSC'), from Repsol E&amp;P, S.à.r.l effective on July 29, 2025, the Group's participating interest  in  the  Corridor  Block  has  been  adjusted  from  46%  to  70%,  after unitization of the Suban Field 10% and Gelam Field 14%.

The  Group's  announces  the  successful  completion  of  the  divestment  of  its entire  share  capital  of  Ophir  Vietnam  Block  12W  B.V.  ('OVBV')  to  Bitexco Energy Company Limited (the 'Transaction') on April 19, 2024. Grup  melakukan  akuisisi  OQ  Exploration  &amp;  Production  (OQEP)  tanggal  12 Desember 2023, dimana wilayah kerjanya berlokasi di Oman, yaitu Blok 60. Estimasi cadangan untuk blok tersebut berdasarkan Dokumentasi Cadangan Internal per 31 Desember 2025, dengan hak partisipasi 20%.

Grup  mengumumkan  keberhasilan  penyelesaian  divestasi  kepemilikannya (24,5%) di Contract Area 47, Libya kepada National Oil Corporation of Libya ("NOC") pada tanggal 27 Mei 2024.

Grup  melakukan  akuisisi  Sakakemang  PSC  tanggal  7  November  2025, dimana wilayah kerjanya berlokasi di Sumatera Selatan yaitu Blok Sakakemang. Estimasi cadangan untuk blok tersebut berdasarkan Sertifikasi Sproule  per  30  November  2019,  Dokumentasi  POD  I  Revisi  Lapangan Kaliberau Dalam per 20 September 2023 dan Dokumentasi Cadangan Internal per 31 Desember 2025, dengan hak partisipasi 45%.

- (6) Grup mengklasifikasikan PT Medco E &amp; P Simenggaris sebagai aset dimiliki untuk  dijual  dan  telah  menandatangani  Perjanjian  Jual  Beli  dengan  kondisi pendahuluan  pada  Februari  2026.  Estimasi  cadangan  Grup  untuk  Blok Simenggaris  (Lapangan  South  Sembakung)  dibuat  berdasarkan  sertifikasi LAPI ITB per 16 Desember 2022, dengan hak partisipasi Grup sebesar 62,5%.

## RESERVES ESTIMATION (continued)

The Group's acquired OQ Exploration &amp; Production (OQEP) on December 12, 2023, whose working area is located in Oman, Block 60. The Group's reserves estimates for Oman Block 60 were based on Internal Reserves Documentation as of December 31, 2025, with Group's effective working interest of 20%.

The  Group's  announces  the  successful  completion  of  the  divestment  of  its holding (24.5%) in Contract Area 47, Libya to the National Oil Corporation of Libya ("NOC') as of May 27, 2024.

The Group's acquired  for  Sakakemang PSC on November 7, 2025, whose working area is located in South Sumatra, Sakakemang Block . The Group's reserves estimates for Sakakemang Block were based on Sproule Certification as of November 30, 2019, POD I Revision Kaliberau Dalam as of September 20, 2023 and Internal Reserves Documentation as of December 31, 2025 with Group's participating interest of 45%.

- (6) The Group has classified PT Medco E &amp; P Simenggaris as assets held for sale and  has  entered  into  a  Sales  and  Purchase  Agreement  with  conditions precedent on February 2026. Estimated reserves of the Group for Simenggaris Block (South Sembakung Field) were made based on LAPI ITB certification as of December 16, 2022, with the Group's participating interest of 62.5%.
